# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 29

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 029 — Mandate 3 (Truth)
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 1 — "God caused to dwell" vs. "God placed to dwell" vs. "God placed inside you to live"
- **EMET:** "God caused to dwell in this flesh"
- **LOGOS:** "God placed to dwell in this flesh"
- **PNEUMA:** "God placed inside you to live in this body"
- **Decision:** "God caused to dwell in this flesh" — katoikizein = cause to dwell/settle; "flesh" (sarx) is the precise word here

### 2. V. 2 — "disown the Lord" vs. "renounce the Lord" vs. "disowning the Lord"
- **EMET:** "disown the Lord"
- **LOGOS:** "renounce the Lord"
- **PNEUMA:** "disowning the Lord"
- **Decision:** "renounce the Lord" — arneomai = deny/renounce; this is the same word used of Peter's denial

### 3. V. 2 — "deposit" — all three agree on this banking metaphor; noted

### 4. V. 2 — "dishonored and defiled" vs. "dishonored and polluted" vs. "defiled and dishonored"
- **EMET:** "dishonored and defiled"
- **LOGOS:** "dishonored and polluted"
- **PNEUMA:** "defiled and dishonored"
- **Decision:** "dishonored and defiled the deposit" — preserve both terms; "defiled" (miainos) and "dishonored" (atimōs) are both in the Greek

### 5. V. 4 — "sanctified" vs. "made holy"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "sanctified"
- **PNEUMA:** "made holy"
- **Decision:** "sanctified" — hagiazontai is the standard sanctification term; preserve it

**Total disagreements: 4**
